components.note: inferred_sex equals the sex of the library inside the FASTQ for every sample (credited only together with gene_counts)

components.name: sample_labels

components.name: de_false_discoveries
components.note: false-discovery proportion among significant genes vs planted truth; full credit <= 0.12, none >= 0.30; scaled down when fewer than half of the planted genes are found

components.name: de_sensitivity
components.note: fraction of planted DE genes called significant with the right sign; full credit >= 0.85, none <= 0.50; scaled down when the false-discovery proportion exceeds 0.30

components.name: de_log2fc
components.note: median |log2fc - planted log2FC| over planted DE genes; full credit <= 0.33, none >= 0.55
